title: Marty Supreme
synopsis: A relentless table-tennis hustler claws his way from smoky Manhattan basements toward a shot at greatness, dragging everyone around him into his obsession.

title: The Secret Agent
synopsis: During Brazil's military dictatorship, a technologist on the run tries to disappear into the crowds of Recife while the past keeps dialing his number.

title: No Other Choice
synopsis: Freshly laid off and running out of options, a mild-mannered paper-factory man decides the only rational move left is to eliminate the competition. Literally.

title: Taxi Driver
synopsis: A sleepless Vietnam veteran drives the night shift through a city he can't stand, tightening toward a violence he mistakes for purpose.

title: Lilo & Stitch
synopsis: A lonely Hawaiian girl adopts what she thinks is a stray dog. It is, in fact, a genetically engineered fugitive from outer space. Ohana ensues.

title: An Elephant Sitting Still
synopsis: Four lives in a grey industrial town circle a single rumor: somewhere in Manzhouli, an elephant sits and ignores the world. Maybe that's the point.

title: Resurrection
synopsis: A woman's carefully rebuilt life starts to unravel the moment a face from her past resurfaces, unchanged, at her front door.

title: Solaris
synopsis: A psychologist sent to a research station orbiting a sentient ocean planet finds the planet answering his grief with visitors who shouldn't exist.

title: Gerry
synopsis: Two friends named Gerry wander off a desert trail for 'the wilderness portion' of a hike and just keep walking, further than either wants to admit.

title: Perfect Days
synopsis: A Tokyo toilet cleaner finds quiet contentment in routine, cassette tapes, and the light through leaves — until his niece shows up unannounced.

title: The Zone of Interest
synopsis: A commandant and his wife build a model garden life for their family, just over the wall from the camp he runs.

title: Challengers
synopsis: A former tennis prodigy turned coach watches her husband face his old best friend and rival across the net — and across everything else.

title: Aftersun
synopsis: Twenty years on, a woman replays camcorder footage from a Turkish package holiday with her father, looking for what she couldn't see at eleven.

title: Past Lives
synopsis: Childhood sweethearts separated by emigration reunite in New York, twenty-four years and one marriage later, for one impossible week.
